fonts.display: 'Tt Commons Pro Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

palette.name: Wine Ink
palette.role: Primary text, primary filled button background, active states, heading color, card borders, and dominant brand stroke — the single chromatic anchor of the entire system

palette.name: Midnight Wine
palette.role: Darkest surface for footer bands and inverted panels

palette.name: Lemon Whisper
palette.role: Decorative accent fill and border — used in illustration blocks, testimonial card outlines, icon highlights, and soft highlight washes

palette.name: Blush Rust
palette.role: Softened brand fill for secondary surfaces and SVG illustration shading

palette.name: Citrine Pop
palette.role: Rare saturated accent for micro-detail and decorative strokes

palette.name: Mauve Ash
palette.role: Muted body text and subtle borders when full brand ink would be too loud

palette.name: Parchment
palette.role: Primary page canvas — the warm ivory that replaces cold white throughout

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Card surfaces, input fields, elevated panels — the brightest neutral layer above the parchment canvas

palette.name: Linen Beige
palette.role: Hairline borders, dividers, ghost button outlines, and subtle UI separators

palette.name: Sandstone
palette.role: Muted borders and secondary divider lines on cards and links

palette.name: Driftwood
palette.role: Lowest-contrast neutral for decorative borders and inactive link text

palette.name: Slate Smoke
palette.role: Body secondary text, icon strokes, and helper copy — the only cool-leaning neutral

palette.name: Charcoal Ink
palette.role: Occasional dark text and info-toned badge borders when Wine Ink would be too warm

palette.name: Butter Cream
palette.role: Ultra-soft warm fill for highlight zones and subtle surface washes

palette.name: Dawn Glow
palette.role: Warm card background tint used sparingly for warm-on-warm contrast

palette.name: Rose Whisper
palette.role: Soft card border accent for warm-toned testimonial and content cards

palette.name: Plum Echo
palette.role: Badge and pill background for muted tag variants
